description: Read an employer's profile by its slug (companySlug on a job): what it does, size, observed pay bands, work arrangement, benefits, recent events and how it is hiring. hiring.definitions says what each hiring number measures: medianOpenPostingAgeDays is the age of open listings, not time to fill, and removedRoles30d counts postings taken down, not roles filled. Its page is https://www.metaintro.com/company/<slug>.
name: get_company
title: Read a company
